style: Real skin texture, natural pores, shot on 35mm, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, moody and intimate, real life, an ordinary moment nobody staged. Palette dominated by black, deep olive and acid lime neon #CCFF00 (a yellow-green, never pure yellow or orange). No text anywhere, no logos, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no other people in focus.
note: The reference is a black and white photo: render the person in natural colour, same face and features.
front: The phone is held low in front of the chest with its screen turned toward the face, as anyone holds a phone: the camera sees only the dark back of the phone, at the bottom of the frame, never the screen.
ots: The screen is seen as the person sees it, in sharp focus, tilted naturally toward the face. It shows one plain, uniform, flat, bright acid lime green colour (#CCFF00) filling the whole display edge to edge: no interface, no picture, no icons, no text. The fingers hold the phone by its edges and do not cover the screen.

shots.scene: Extreme macro close-up photograph of one human eye of the woman from the reference image, vertical, the eye filling most of the frame, wide open and looking straight into the camera: real skin texture, fine eyelashes, a hazel-green iris with every fibre visible, wet glint on the cornea. On the curved surface of the eye, over the pupil, the small bright reflection of a phone screen she is looking at: a soft acid lime rectangle.
shots.light: That screen is the only light: a soft acid lime glow from below on the lower lid, the lashes and the skin around the eye; everything else falls into black. Bright enough to read in the first second.

shots.scene: Wide cinematic night photograph, vertical, of the facade of a tall apartment building seen from across a dark street: a grid of dozens of windows. In many of the windows a different person sits or stands alone looking down at a phone held low, the screen facing them, never the camera, their faces lit acid lime from below; small human figures, no one in focus. Some windows are dark.
shots.light: The lime glows in the windows are the brightest things in the picture; the rest of the city is dark: a few warm street lights at the bottom, wet asphalt, a black sky.
